article.story: STEPHENVILLE, Texas -- — Trevan Leonhardt scored 20 points as Utah Valley beat Tarleton State 83-55 on Thursday. Leonhardt added five rebounds and three steals for the Wolverines (16-6, 6-3 Western Athletic Conference). Isaac Davis scored 17 points, going 7 of 7 from the field. Isaac Hawkins finished with 10 points, while adding seven rebounds and four blocks. Kaia Isaac led the Texans (11-10, 2-6) in scoring, finishing with 13 points. Cam McDowell added 12 points and two steals for Tarleton State. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
